errata.orig: For an NA message in response to an address resolution NS or DAD NS, the PE MUST use IP1 as the IP SA and Target Address. M1 MUST be used as the Target Link Local Address (TLLA).
errata.correct: For an NA message in response to an address resolution NS or DAD NS, the PE MUST use IP1 as the IP SA and Target Address. MAC1 MUST be used as the Target Link Local Address (TLLA).
errata.notes: The symbolic identifier MAC1 is used inconsistently in the section 3.3: MAC1 versus M1.
